subject: RFP: Assurance package request & SIG/ISO/SOC2 control mapping
messages:
From: Anita Gomes <anita.gomes@novapoint.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Novapoint Procurement <rfp@novapoint.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RFP: Assurance package request & SIG/ISO/SOC2 control mapping

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking part in our RFP. Attached is the most recent SIG spreadsheet (Novapoint_SIG_v6.xlsx) and the RFP questionnaire. To progress the security/compliance section we need: 

- A control mapping that ties Redwood controls to SIG, SOC 2 CC, and ISO 27001 clauses (spreadsheet preferred).
- Representative evidence for the following controls: KMS usage and key rotation proof, encryption-in-transit and at-rest descriptions, and 90 days of access/auth logs (redacted samples acceptable).
- Clarification on private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and network segregation controls.

Please confirm if you can provide a draft mapping and a package of sample artifacts by our RFP deadline, Aug 10. If you have a standard SOC 2 bridge letter or ISO statement of applicability you can share that would also be helpful.

We may ask for a short remote walkthrough of the architecture and key controls after we review the artifacts.

Best,
Anita Gomes
Senior Security Sourcing Manager
Novapoint Systems
(attachment: Novapoint_SIG_v6.xlsx)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gomes <anita.gomes@novapoint.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Assurance package request & SIG/ISO/SOC2 control mapping

Hi Anita — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. We can absolutely produce a control crosswalk and collect sample artifacts for your review. Proposed plan below: 

- By Aug 6: Deliver a draft control mapping (redwood-control-mapping-novapoint.xlsx) mapping SIG rows -> SOC 2 CC & ISO 27001 controls, with owners and evidence pointers.
- By Aug 10: Deliver evidence package containing: SOC 2 bridge letter, representative KMS logs (rotation events), and 90-day sample auth/access logs (redacted).
- Aug 3 week: Optional 45-minute walkthrough to run through the mapping and any questions you have.

Owners on our side: Kimberly Park will pull KMS/key rotation artifacts and provide the technical appendix; Priyom Das will assemble SOC 2 bridge materials and control narratives. I'll shepherd the mapping and be the main point of contact for questions.

Couple of quick clarifying items so we deliver correctly: 
1) For access logs, do you need full session traces or just authentication/authorization events (fail/success/privilege escalation)?
2) For KMS proof, do you require proof of customer-managed key usage or is Redwood-managed KMS metadata sufficient?

If you can confirm those two points I will lock the timeline.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-control-mapping-novapoint.xlsx)

From: Anita Gomes <anita.gomes@novapoint.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Novapoint Procurement <rfp@novapoint.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Assurance package request & SIG/ISO/SOC2 control mapping

Hi Chloe — quick clarifications: 

- Access logs: authentication and authorization events are what we need (successful/failed logins, API tokens issuance/rotation, admin privilege elevation). Full session recordings are not required; aggregated redacted samples are acceptable so long as timestamps and user/host identifiers are present.
- KMS: For encryption-at-rest we need evidence that keys are rotated and that encryption operations are performed; metadata from Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable if it shows rotation history and key identifiers. If you offer customer-managed key options, please note how that would change evidence ownership.

Also, we need a signed SOC 2 bridge letter and any relevant certification docs where available. Can you confirm if Aug 3 at 10:00am ET works for a walkthrough? I've included a DocuSign powerform link for any signature items: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=11111111&v=2

Thanks — if you can send a timeline + sample list today that would be great.

Best,
Anita
(attachment: Novapoint_SIG_v6.xlsx)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gomes <anita.gomes@novapoint.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Assurance package request & SIG/ISO/SOC2 control mapping

Anita — thanks for the clarifications and the DocuSign link. Confirming plan and what we'll upload: 

Deliverables and timing:
- Aug 2 (by EOD): 
  - Draft control crosswalk: redwood-control-mapping-novapoint.xlsx (SIG -> SOC 2 CC -> ISO 27001 mapping)
  - Proposed evidence index with explicit file names and redaction notes
- Aug 6 (by EOD): 
  - Sample artifacts zip: sample-auth-logs-90d.csv (redacted), kms-key-rotation-logs-2027-2028.csv (rotation events metadata), and a short architecture diagram (attachment stub).
- Aug 10: Final evidence packet + signed SOC 2 bridge letter (redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-2027.pdf) delivered via secure link.

Walkthrough:
- Aug 3 at 10:00am ET works for us. We'll plan a 45-min session. Dial-in and calendar invite will follow from our side.

Notes/assumptions:
- Logs will be redacted to remove PII and customer identifiers; we'll include a redaction manifest describing which fields were removed.
- If you require customer-managed KMS artifacts rather than Redwood-managed metadata, please flag and we'll provide a statement describing options and operational impact.

Attachments to follow: redwood-control-mapping-novapoint.xlsx, sample-auth-logs-90d.csv (redacted), kms-key-rotation-logs-2027-2028.csv, redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-2027.pdf (signed).

Thanks — Kimberly and Priyom are cc'd and will own the artifact pulls.

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood-control-mapping-novapoint.xlsx, sample-auth-logs-90d.csv, kms-key-rotation-logs-2027-2028.csv, redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-2027.pdf)
